title: Psalms 122
paragraphs: ¹ I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD." ² Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem. ³ Jerusalem is built like a city that is firmly joined together, ⁴ where the tribes go up — the tribes of the LORD — as was commanded for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD. ⁵ There the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

⁶ Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: may those who love you be secure. ⁷ May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels. ⁸ For the sake of my brothers and friends I will say, "Peace be within you." ⁹ For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
